in_sanskrit.name: अग्निराज
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ruler of Fire, God of Fire

in_marathi.name: Agniraaj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Agniraaj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Agniraaj is derived from Agni, the god of fire, and Raja, the king. In Hindu mythology, Agniraaj represents the king of the fire gods.
